gate_type: CORRECTION gate (no redesign) — VF-vNEXT-R5-C01: make the repository root the canonical Virtual Factory entrypoint and stop serving the experimental Continuous dashboard there. Small, bounded correction on top of the R5 consolidation head.
objective: GET / must become the CANONICAL VF entrypoint: redirect / -> /workspaces (the canonical Workspace Shell), stop serving the legacy continuous dashboard (index.html) at root, keep the continuous static assets reference-only, register no continuous workspace, restore/rebuild nothing from Continuous, prove with a regression that GET / resolves to the canonical shell and constructs ZERO runtime state, and preserve every R1-R5 regression with a green baseline and full suite.
explicit_non_objectives: No redesign and no new feature work
No continuous workspace registration and no Continuous restore/rebuild
No changes to the canonical rich ASSY UI, the workspace shell behaviour, or the de-authorized legacy families beyond the root entrypoint
No gateway/OPC/MQTT/Kafka work and no PIM/MES change
No deletion of the retained reference-only static assets
required_deliverables: src/virtual_factory/ui/api.py (GET / -> 307 redirect to /workspaces; no dashboard at root; create_app docstring de-staled)
tests/test_ui_hierarchy.py (legacy dashboard page test migrated to reference-only)
required_smoke_checks: Browser smoke STARTING FROM / : must land in the canonical workspace shell with no severe console errors
Canonical baseline green at the pushed head (all 43 groups incl. r5_single_system)
forbidden_actions: Serving the legacy continuous dashboard at root
Constructing any runtime state while resolving the root entrypoint
Registering a continuous workspace or restoring Continuous behaviour
stop_conditions: The correction would require touching SH-WTP, the rich ASSY UI, or a de-authorized legacy family beyond the root entrypoint
Preserving R1-R5 regressions would require a redesign
The root entrypoint cannot be made canonical without constructing runtime state

acceptance_criteria.description: GET / is the canonical entrypoint: redirects to /workspaces and serves no continuous dashboard
Resolving GET / constructs ZERO runtime state (no RuntimeService/session/engine/controller)
Legacy continuous dashboard assets retained reference-only (present in repo, not served at root); no continuous workspace registered
Regression added; browser smoke from / reaches the canonical shell without severe console errors
R1-R5 preserved: full suite and the 43-group canonical baseline green at the pushed head
